categories.main_business_segments: Union Semiconductor (Hefei) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in high-end advanced packaging and testing services for integrated circuits, focusing on display driver chips. The company offers full-process packaging and testing services including bumping, wafer testing, chip-on-glass (COG), and chip-on-film (COF) packaging. Its products mainly serve LCD, OLED, and AMOLED display panels used in smartphones, high-definition TVs, laptops, tablets, automotive electronics, smart wearables, and electronic labels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in advanced packaging technologies such as gold bumping, wafer grinding and thinning, high-precision wafer dicing, and high-precision inner lead bonding. It applies flip-chip (FC) technology and advanced packaging methods including glass and film chip-on packaging (COG and COF). The firm is developing new bumping processes using copper-nickel-gold and palladium to reduce gold usage and costs. It also invests in Fan-out, 2.5D/3D, and system-in-package (SiP) technologies to enhance chip integration and performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Its key customers are integrated circuit design companies specializing in display driver chips. The end markets include major display panel manufacturers such as BOE, Visionox, and AU Optronics, serving consumer electronics like smartphones, high-definition TVs, laptops, tablets, automotive displays, and emerging AR/VR applications. The company’s services support the upstream IC design and wafer foundry sectors by providing packaging and testing solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and main production facilities in Hefei, Anhui Province, and a wholly-owned subsidiary in Yangzhou, Jiangsu Province. Its customer base and supply chain extend to mainland China, Taiwan, South Korea, and other Asian markets. The company benefits from its location in the Yangtze River Delta, a major integrated circuit industry cluster.
categories.supply_chain_position: Union Semiconductor operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on outsourced semiconductor assembly and testing (OSAT). It does not engage in IC design or wafer manufacturing but provides critical packaging and testing services that connect upstream wafer fabrication and downstream display panel assembly and end-product manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes advancing high-density, fine-pitch bumping technology and expanding 12-inch wafer packaging capacity. It invests heavily in R&D to develop new bumping materials (copper-nickel-gold, palladium), improve yield and reliability, and explore next-generation packaging technologies such as Fan-out, 2.5D/3D, and SiP. The firm also focuses on expanding into automotive-grade chips and storage chip packaging, enhancing quality management, and building a world-class R&D and management team through talent acquisition and retention.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through customized packaging and testing service fees charged to IC design companies. The company operates under an OSAT model, providing full-process packaging and testing services based on customer wafer inputs and specific technical requirements. Pricing is negotiated per project, factoring in material costs (notably gold usage) and processing complexity. The company also earns income from selling scrap materials and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Union Semiconductor is among the leading advanced packaging and testing service providers for display driver chips in mainland China, competing with established players like Tongfu Microelectronics, JCET, and Hua Tian Technology, as well as Taiwan-based firms like Chipbond and Nanmao Technology. It holds a strong position due to its early adoption of gold bumping technology, full-process capabilities on 8-inch and 12-inch lines, and deep customer relationships. However, competition is intensifying with new entrants expanding capacity and pricing pressure in the display driver chip segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.5 billion, a 21.22% increase year-over-year, driven by capacity expansion and stable downstream demand. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 159.76 million, down 18.48% due to increased depreciation and financial costs. Total assets grew 27.67% to RMB 4.59 billion, and net assets increased 2.20% to RMB 3.20 billion. The company maintains a positive cash flow from operations and continues to invest heavily in capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Union Semiconductor emphasizes its advanced bumping technology with micro-pitch gold bumps enabling high integration and miniaturization of display driver chips. Its full-process packaging and testing capabilities on both 8-inch and 12-inch wafers provide efficiency, quality, and cost advantages. The company’s strong R&D, high yield rates (>99.9%), and close collaboration with leading IC design and panel manufacturers differentiate it in a competitive market. Its strategic location within a mature semiconductor cluster enhances supply chain responsiveness and cost control.
